Rooms.Name: Ambush!
Rooms.Description:
Rocky terrain surrounds this darkened part of the caverns.  The sound
of dripping water echoes throughout.  There are a few boulders piled here,
and footprints are marked in the dust on the ground.  The tunnel continues
to the north.

Exits.Description: The cavern leads off to the north.

Rooms.Name: Near the Boulders
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel is smaller here, in part due to what looks like some caved
in rubble.  Boulders litter the exits south and north, but you are certain
that you can squeeze through.

Exits.Description: The boulders to the south almost block the way.
The boulders to the north almost block the way.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Tunnels
Rooms.Description:
The floor here is covered with a thin layer of slime, with powdery
cobwebs stuck everywhere.  Boulders almost block off the way back south,
but the way west is clear.

Exits.Description: There are boulders almost blocking this way.
You hear footsteps to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Dark Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnels are very dark, and it is hard to see anything clearly.  The
walls glisten with a strange black light, shining through the sticky
cobwebs that cling to them.  The tunnel leads east and west.

Exits.Description: You can see boulders to the east.
The strange black light beckons you.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the Dark Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel is a little wider here, and the walls are rather smooth.
They glisten with a strange black light, and are covered in white cobwebs.
The tunnel leads to the north and to the east.

Exits.Description: You can hear cries north of here.
The tunnel east is dark.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the Dark Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel is very refined here, and there are signs that it was made by
hand, and not by nature.  The walls glow with an eerie black light.  Fresh 
air blows in from the south, while eerie cries echo from the west.

Exits.Description: Fresh air blows in from the south.
You think you see a guard post.

Rooms.Name: East of the Slave Camp
Rooms.Description:
A small wooden guard post has been set up in this part of the tunnels.
A few chairs, made out of an odd-looking black wood, rest on the floor.
The tunnel is a t-section, leading off to what appears to be a niche in
the north.  The tunnels lead east, into the darkness, and west, into the
Drow slave camp.

Exits.Description: You see a small cave north of here.
You see the eerie black tunnels east of here.
The drow slave camp echoes with the cries of tortured prisoners.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Slave Camp
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the entrance ledge to a large cavern.  There are
several hewn pockets that have been blocked off, and in each you can hear
the echoes of people being tortured.  You think you see movement around
the area, but it is hard to tell.  Small, booted footprints mark the dust
where you stand.  There are exits in all directions - out, to the east, or
further into the slave camp.

Exits.Description: You see a small slave pen north of here.
You can leave the slave camp this way.
You can climb south into the caverns.
You can climb west into the caverns.

Rooms.Name: A slave pen
Rooms.Description:
This cave has been converted into a slave pen, and from the dried
stains of blood that splatter the walls, you guess that it's been a slave
pen for many years now.  The walls have shackles rivetted into them, and
there are signs that the drow used to make people dig into the walls, in
search of jewels.  The only exit is to the south.

Exits.Description: The caverns lead out.

Rooms.Name: The slave caverns
Rooms.Description:
This is the south-east corner of the large slave cavern.  It appears
that there is another such cavern far to the north-west.  The ground is
very muddy and the walls are sticky and slimy.  The air here is so musty
that you have problems breathing, and you wonder how anyone could live in
this environment... but maybe that is what the drow have in mind.

Exits.Description: The north-east corner of the cavern.
The south-west corner of the cavern.

Rooms.Name: Near the Boulders
Rooms.Description:
This is the south-west corner of the slave caverns.  You are wading
around in blood and grit, and the smell of infection hangs heavy in the
air.  It looks like there was a cave-in here, and a few boulders have
piled up to the south.

Exits.Description: The north-west corner of the cavern.
The south-east corner of the cavern.
There is a path past the boulder!

Rooms.Name: A tunnel in the slave cavern
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the north-west part of the slave cavern.  This area
is a small tunnel-like area that connects the two parts of the slave
cavern.  To the west you can see the deeper section of the caverns, and
there are exits to the east and south.

Exits.Description: You can see the north-east part of the slave-cavern.
You can see the south-west part of the slave-cavern.
The deeper part of the slave-cavern is in this direction.

Rooms.Name: The deeper slave cavern
Rooms.Description:
The cavern you are standing in is the deeper part of the slave pens.
This is where the most suffering goes on.  The ground is litterered with
bones and debris, all splattered with blood.  It is even darker here than
anywhere else in the caverns, except for the occasional gleam of eyes
staring out of the darkness.

Exits.Description: The cavern leads off to the north.
This is the exit from the deep section.
The cavern leads off to the west.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the slave pens
Rooms.Description:
The room here smells of musty sweat and blood.  You can only dread what
will happen to you if the drow capture you.

Exits.Description: You can see the way out south of here.
The deepest part of the pens is to the west.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the slave pens
Rooms.Description:
You are so deep within the slave pens that you can no longer hear the
sound of dripping water or smell fresh air.  Dried blood decorates the
walls.

Exits.Description: The way out is to the east.
You see glinting metal south of here.

Rooms.Name: The room of shackles
Rooms.Description:
You are now very deep within the tunnels that make up the drow slave
pens.  The dark elves themselves rarely venture as far as you have for
fear of being killed by their own slaves.  The walls are almost completly
covered with metallic shackles, each with a prisoner or bones in its iron
grip.

Exits.Description: The farthest part of the slave pens is to the north.
The way out is to the east.

Rooms.Name: Past the boulders
Rooms.Description:
It doesn't look like there is a tunnel here from the other side of this
boulder.  The cries from the slave pen can be heard from the north, but to
the south, all is quiet.  You wonder what manner of creature would ever
want to hide here.  You can squeeze north through the boulder, or go south
into the darker tunnels.

Exits.Description: The slave pens are past the boulder.
The tunnels are covered in cobwebs.

Rooms.Name: The silent tunnels
Rooms.Description:
It is almost completely quiet in these tunnels.  Compared to the slave
pens that came before them, they at first seem soothing and comforting,
but tunnels that are soothing and comforting almost always have the sounds
of dripping water and  underground life.  They also don't normally glow
with that eerie black light, and have cobwebs covering them.  The green
slime that is crawling along the walls is also unnerving.  You can travel
north, out towards a large boulder, or west, furthur into these mysterious
tunnels.

Exits.Description: There is a boulder north of here.
You can travel furthur into the tunnels west.

Rooms.Name: Near the web bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small ledge deep within the tunnels.  A white,
glistening web stretches out to the west, and you think you see it connect
to the other side of the chasm beneath you.

Exits.Description: The tunnels are dark to the east.
The web bridge stretches across to the west.

Rooms.Name: On the web bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are in the middle of a bright white bridge made entirely of strong,
sticky strands of web.  Beneath you is a large chasm that seems to go to
eternity.  To the east is a large cavernous opening where the web is
attached, and it looks like you can also climb off the web to the south.
The web is shaking slightly as though someone other than you is on it.

Exits.Description: The east side of the web bridge.
The south side of the web bridge.

Rooms.Name: Near the web bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a small ledge deep within the tunnels.  A white,
glistening web stretches out to the north, and you think you see it
connect to the other side of the chasm beneath you.  The tunnel to the
south seems to lead into a cavern of some sort.

Exits.Description: You can climb onto the web bridge this way.
You can enter into a dark cavern this way.

Rooms.Name: The entrance to the spider cave
Rooms.Description:
There is no other name for it, this must be the spider cave.  Arachnids
are crawling all over the place, and webs cover the walls.  You have to
push past hanging cobwebs and dead insects (and animals) to get into and
out of the cave.  To the north you can see what looks like a large web.
To the south and east you hear more spiders.

Exits.Description: The bridge is to the north.
You hear spiders to the east.
You hear spiders and screams to the south.

Rooms.Name: The spider cave
Rooms.Description:
There are spiders everywhere!  What this place needs is a good fireball,
and you'd do it, do, if it wasn't for all the flammable webbing that would
turn these caves into a blazing inferno.  Some of the bundles in the web
are almost mansized, implying great size on the part of the spiders.

Exits.Description: The cave goes to the north.
The cave goes to the east.

Rooms.Name: Deep within the spider cave
Rooms.Description:
There is a small pile of pundles wrapped in webbing that surround this
place.  The webs themselves seem as strong as iron, but there are teeth
marks in the bundles.  Spiders crawl all over the place, getting into all
of your possessions.

Exits.Description: The cavern goes to the north.
The cavern goes to the west.

Rooms.Name: A lair
Rooms.Description:
This is obviously a lair of some large creature.  There is a massive
nest that has been built of webbing and bone, and you can see the
occasional finger sticking out of it.  It looks like there might be some
eggs in the nest.  The walls are covered with web and the floor crunches
with dead spiders with every step you take.  You can go on to the west or
to the south.

Exits.Description: The cavern goes to the south.
The cavern leaves to the west.

Rooms.Name: A small niche
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small niche in the caverns.  To the south is the
way out.  It appears that there is nothing of interest in this sticky,
slimy niche, but perhaps you should take a closer look at those boulders
at your feet.

Exits.Description: This is the way out of the niche.
The boulders block the way down from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The boulders look like they block a passageway down into the caverns.

Rooms.Name: A tunnel leading down
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel continues down.  You can squeeze through boulders above or
below.

Exits.Description: There are boulders blocking the way up.
There are boulders blocking the way down.

Rooms.Name: At the bottom of the tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You are at the bottom of a long tunnel.  A massive cavern looms to the
north, and it looks like there is a street in front of you.  A cave-in of
boulders blocks the passage above you.

Exits.Description: There is a street north of here.
Boulders block the way up.

Rooms.Name: The entrance to Shaalziran'dar
Rooms.Description:
You have heard of this city in legends told throughout Midgaard, but
never in all of your short life did you think you would see this terror.
A terror it is, the stuff of nightmares.  Huge buildings loom in the
softly illuminated darkness, carved with magic from the very black rock of
the caverns.  This is perhaps one of the deadliest of the drow cities, as
it is not burdened by struggle between rival houses.  House Azzinoden
destroyed all of its foes centuries ago with ruthless precision.  Stories
such as this one give you reason never to make a foe of a drow.  The
street you are on goes to the west and the east.

Exits.Description: There is a niche to the south.
The street goes to the east.
The street goes to the west.

Rooms.Name: The corner by the Academy
Rooms.Description:
The Academy of Swordplay is a large, imposing construction, ripped from
the walls of the cavern into the shape of a diabolical building.  It
towers over this part of the street on the east side.  The building itself
glows with a soft, eerie light, illuminating the street outside.  The
street goes north and west, or you can foolishly travel east, into the
Academy.

Exits.Description: The street goes to the north.
The Academy of Swordplay is to the east.
The street leads to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Academy of Swordplay
Rooms.Description:
This is the entrance room to the Academy of Swordplay.  All dark elves
attend this Academy in their youth, whether they like it or not.  Here,
they are taught how to kill people, a talent they will hone throughout
their entire lives.  Those who do not, die.  There is an exit to the west,
or you can walk into the Academy.

Exits.Description: You can wisely leave the Academy.
You can foolishly enter the Academy.

Rooms.Name: The corridor in the Academy
Rooms.Description:
The Academy has the job of teaching drow how to fight.  You are inside
the building, built out of black wood and magically hewn rock, outside the
first room of training.  A sign on the wall here translates into
"Brutality", one of the many virtues a drow must master to be a successful
citizen.  Those who do not become what the others practice on in class.  A
training room is south of here, and the softly glowing black wooden floor
stretches towards the east and north.

Exits.Description: You can wisely leave.
The wooden floors go east.
The Chamber of Brutality is south of here.

Rooms.Name: The Chamber of Brutality
Rooms.Description:
This is the Chamber of Brutality, where dark elves learn the art of
pain.  The walls are stained a horrid black-red color, a nasty blend of
the natural black rock and wood and the unnaturally spilled drow blood.
A weapons rack lines the wall, as does a torture rack.  Both seem to have
seen extensive use in training the drow to be warriors.

Exits.Description: The corridor is north of here.

Rooms.Name: The corridor in the Academy
Rooms.Description:
The black wood covers the floor here in long, carefully carved rows.
The walls are made of a solid black rock that glows with a disturbing soft
light.  The corridor goes east and west, or you can go south, into a large
room.  A sign over the room is translated as "Swiftness."

Exits.Description: The corridor goes furthur east.
You can enter the Chamber of Swiftness.
You can go west, down the corridor.

Rooms.Name: The Chamber of Swiftness
Rooms.Description:
This is a large room carved out of black rock, with strange looking
black wood lining the walls and floor.  The room glows with an eerie
light.  There are several strange constructions that appear to be some
kind of spring loaded mechanisms.  There are also shackles hanging on the
walls that appear well used.  The artifacts in this room don't lend too
much insight into how the drow test their swiftness, but the ample supply
of blood that stains the walls and floor can only convey an image that
belongs in nightmares.

Exits.Description: You can go back to the corridor.

Rooms.Name: The end of the corridor
Rooms.Description:
The corridor ends here.  The wall is more natural here, as if the
Academy ends right where the cliff face begins.  You can go west, down the
corridor, or south, into a chamber marked with the word "Style".

Exits.Description: The Chamber of Style is south of here.
The corridor goes west.

Rooms.Name: The Chamber of Style
Rooms.Description:
This is a large chamber with several ropes and pullies stretches across
the black wooden floor, hooked up at several points on the walls.  Blood
stains most of the equipment here.  Shackles hang from the walls with
blood still wet in the manacles.  This is the chamber where drow learn to
fight with finesse and style, to both impress and terrify their enemies.
There are intricately drawn diagrams on the walls explaining points of
warfare to the students in a very gruesome manner, and there is little
your disturbed mind finds stylish about it.

Exits.Description: You can leave the chamber.

Rooms.Name: A road in the Drow city
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a road in the drow city.  The road is carved right
out of the rock, but the artistic flair of the drow is visible in the
beautiful mosaic that they insist on putting down.  A small house stands
to the west, while the road leads off to the north and east.

Exits.Description: The road leads north.
The road leads east.
There is a small house to the west.

Rooms.Name: A drow weaponshop
Rooms.Description:
This house is carved from black granite rock and decorated with eerie
black woodwork.  The entire structure glows faintly with the odd purple
whiteish glow that lights up the entire city.  A mural of a spider
decorates the wall.  There is a weapons rack on the wall.

Exits.Description: The road is outside the house.

Rooms.Name: A road in the drow city
Rooms.Description:
The road leads north and south.  The entire street is decorated with an
intricate, glowing mosaic.  You can see a large stone structure, a natural
piece of beauty, blocking off the area east of the street.  A small house
stands to the west, and furthur in the distance, you can see a looming
palace.

Exits.Description: The road leads furthur north.
The road leads to the south.
You see a small building to the east.

Rooms.Name: A drow armoury
Rooms.Description:
This small house is built into a massive stalagmite, with wooden
supports constructed from the dark elven wood.  The rock seems to embrace
the structure, like a massive spider embracing its kill.  The building
itself is warm inside, and in the back, you can see some pieces of armour.

Exits.Description: You can leave the armoury.

Rooms.Name: The fork in the road
Rooms.Description:
The road in the drow city forks here.  You can travel to the east,
towards a small cluster of buildings, or to the west, towards the palace.
You can see the palace clearly from here as it looms over the entire city,
as if it, too, were watching.

Exits.Description: You can go to the east.
You can go to the south.
You can travel east, towards the palace.

Rooms.Name: The north road of the drow city
Rooms.Description:
This is the northern road in the city, leading east and west on the far
side of the stalagmite.  A small building peeks out to the north.  You can
make out the massive, nightmarish structure of the palace to the west, and
you can see the northern district of the city to the east.

Exits.Description: There is a small shop with goods in it to the north.
The road towards the entertainment district leads east.
The road towards the palace leads west.

Rooms.Name: The drow general goods store
Rooms.Description:
This large building is lined with black wooden shelves, filled with a
variety of bottles, jars, and bags.  The rock walls glow with an eerie
light, and you can see spiders crawling throughout a sack that has food in
it.

Exits.Description: You can leave the general store.

Rooms.Name: The east road
Rooms.Description:
The east road leads north and south.  It's called the east road because
it is on the east side of a huge, monstrous stalagmite.  The road leads to
the south, towards what looks like a large barracks, and to the north,
towards two large buildings.  To the east is a small building that glows
softly with an eerie green light.

Exits.Description: The road leads towards the entertainment district.
There is a softly glowing building to the east.
The road towards the military academy is south of here.

Rooms.Name: The home of Retelzin
Rooms.Description:
Releyzin, the drow magician, makes his home here.  He is a little less
psychopathic then most dark elves, and will occasionally deal with people
who are not drow.  His house is a most bizarre structure, with dead people
hanging from the walls, victims of his failed experiments.  The only exit
is to the west.

Exits.Description: The way out of Retelzin's house.

Rooms.Name: The north side
Rooms.Description:
You are on the north side of the city.  The road leads off towards the
west, where you can barely make out what appears to be a massive, black
granite palace.  A large building is visible to the south, as are two to
the north.  Cries of pain and pleasure shoot from the north.  A small
landslide can be seen to the east.  The road itself is very beautiful, and
is decorated by a marvelous mosaic.

Exits.Description: The entrance to the entertainment district.
A landslide is to the east.
The road to the south leads to the academy.
The road to the west leads to the palace.

Rooms.Name: The end of the mosaic road
Rooms.Description:
The road ends here.  The mosaic also stops, in a fascinating climactic
scene.  If you like, you can go south of here, back into the main part of
the city, but these buildings seem more interesting.  To the north, you
can see several torture devices, and to the east, you hear water bubbling.

Exits.Description: The torture house is north of here.
The pleasure house is east of here.
The main city is south of here.

Rooms.Name: The drow bath house
Rooms.Description:
Drow are a highly refined race, and enjoy the finer pleasures of life. 
This structure of blackwood and granite rock is very warm, and you can
hear water bubbling within.  Towels hang on onyx outcrops on the walls,
and steam wafts out above through air ducts.  You can leave to the west,
or go furthur into the bath house.

Exits.Description: There is bubbling to the north.
There is bubbling to the east.
It is cooler to the west.

Rooms.Name: The drow bath chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is very warm, and the eerie black-rock walls glisten when the
strange light refracts through the many water droplets.  In the center of
the room is a carefully carved granite bathtub, large enough for many drow
to bathe together.  An onyx clothes rack stands next to the bath, with
many silky black garments hanging from it.

Exits.Description: It feels cooler to the east.
It feels cooler to the south.

Rooms.Name: The drow massage parlour
Rooms.Description:
This room is shielded from the rest of the bath house by black silk
curtains.  Several wooden beds with soft sheets have been set up, with
short stools resting next to them.  A small onyx clothes rack has been set
up in this room, and many drow dresses and shirts hang from it.

Exits.Description: It is warmer to the south.
It is warmer to the west.

Rooms.Name: The drow bath chamber
Rooms.Description:
This chamber has several large above-ground baths make of a softly
glowing purplish-black rock.  They are filled with bubbling water, heated
by some unknown source.  It is very warm in here, and many rock benches
have been placed for people to sit and sweat in the heat.  Silky clothes
hang from the wall, adding weight to the knowledge that the drow have very
little in the way of a nudity taboo.

Exits.Description: It feels cooler to the north.
It feels cooler to the west.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the drow torture chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is slightly less illuminated than the rest of the drow city,
but still glows with the eerie purplish light that keeps the city lit.  A
rack is set up on the far wall, and several carving tools rest on a shelf.
The room is surprisingly clean for a torture chamber, and not a drop of
blood stains the equipment.  Everything is kept tidy, neat, and almost
clinical.  You can make out more torture devices to the north and west.

Exits.Description: Heat wafts from the north.
You can leave to the south.
You hear cries to the west.

Rooms.Name: The branding room
Rooms.Description:
A large steel stove generates the heat that warms this disturbing room.
A shelf on the wall has some branding irons hanging from it, all of them
glowing slightly red from recent use.  The smell of burnt flesh is very
heavy in here.  Darksteel shackles line the walls, some with bones still
smoldering in them.

Exits.Description: You can run out to the south.
It seems quieter to the west.

Rooms.Name: The spider pit
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a very large chamber, lined with arena seating.
Green smoke wafts out of a large, gaping pit in the center of the room.
You hear a wretched clicking noise coming from the pit.  Blood stains the
edges of the abyss, and cobwebs dangle from the ceiling above it.

Exits.Description: It is warm to the east.
It is quiet to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Room of Death
Rooms.Description:
Even in a building dedicated to pain, eventually some drow cross the
path of the Matron Mother in a less than biblical sense.  Those who do,
end up here to die.  A few iron maidens, tastefully cleaned and polished,
stand in the corner, and the ceiling is covered with hanging nooses.  A
few have skeletons in them.  The floor has red carpetting covering it, to
conceal any damage done should someone be executed messily.

Exits.Description: It seems quiet to the north.
You can flee to the east.

Rooms.Name: The entrance to the Matron Mother's palace
Rooms.Description:
You are standing next to the massive palace that is the home of the
Matron Mother.  House Azzinoden dwells here, and oversees the city with
ruthless efficiency.  The palace is huge, its large purplish-black rock
structure towering over the drow city.  You can see that one of its
spires reaches right to the cavern ceiling.

Exits.Description: The street leads away from the palace.
You can enter the palace.

Rooms.Name: Inside the palace
Rooms.Description:
You are in a corridor inside the drow palace.  It is quieter inside
here than it was in the city.  The floors have a thin leather carpetting
of some strange black beast covering them, and the walls are painted with
scenes you have only seen in your nightmares.  The corridor goes to the
north and the south, or you can leave the palace to the east.

Exits.Description: You can go north along the corridor.
You can wisely flee the palace.
You can travel to the south.

Rooms.Name: A corridor in the palace
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a corridor in the drow palace.  The walls are
carved right out of the mountainside, and glisten strangely in the purple
light that illuminates the castle.  The corridor leads to the north and
west, or you can enter the chamber to the south.

Exits.Description: The corridor leads north.
A small room is south of here.
The corridor goes to the west.

Rooms.Name: A small guard chamber
Rooms.Description:
This small room is a little off the main hallway in the drow palace.
It has a few portraits on the wall of dark elven heroes and deities, and
the walls are covered in an exquisitely painful spider mural.  Seats have
been set up for guards to sit on when they are off duty, and a table sits
in the middle with a few bottles of dark elven wine resting on it.

Exits.Description: The corridor is north of here.

Rooms.Name: The hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hallway continues to the west and to the east.  You can also see a
small room sitting off to the south, behind a silky black curtain.

Exits.Description: The hallway goes east.
There is a room beyond the southern curtain.
The corridor goes west.

Rooms.Name: A small side-room
Rooms.Description:
You brush past a silky black curtain and find a small side room.  This
room is warm and nicely scented with drow perfume, and a few barriers are
set up so that the dark elves can change clothes when they choose.  A
variety of drow clothes hang from them.

Exits.Description: You can leave the changing room.

Rooms.Name: A corner in the hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hallway turns towards the north here.  To the west you see a small
study, and you think you can hear voices in the room to the south.  These
hallways are surprisingly well illumunated, a tribute to drow magical
talent.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues to the north.
The hallway continues to the east.
You can see a small room south of here.
You can see a small study west of here.

Rooms.Name: A small chamber
Rooms.Description:
This small room is off the main corridor.  The floor has a mosaic
imprinted in it, depicting a large spider ripping a pathetic elf to
shreds.

Exits.Description: You can leave this chamber.

Rooms.Name: A small study
Rooms.Description:
Shelves line the walls of this study.  This is one of the few drow
rooms that is actually bright, and a few candles can actually be seen in
here.  A desk is on the far side of the room, and papers clutter it.  A
bed has been set up in this room in case a drow studies past the many days
that they can stay awake.  The short black skirt and blouse on the unmade
bed show that someone has been studying here.

Exits.Description: You can leave the study.

Rooms.Name: The hallway in the drow palace
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a long hallway in the drow palace.  The hallway
continues to the north and south.  You can see a spiral staircase to the
east, and to the west is a small study.

Exits.Description: You see the corridor turn to the north.
You see stairs to the east.
You see the corridor turn to the south.
You see a small study west of here.

Rooms.Name: A small drow study
Rooms.Description:
This small room is sheltered from the rest of the palace.  It is quiet
here, and a cool breeze blows through air ducts in the ceiling.  The walls
are carved right into the mountain, and have been magically polished so
that they glow with a purple light.  A desk decorates the middle of the
room, with a bookshelf behind it.

Exits.Description: You can leave the study.

Rooms.Name: The north bend
Rooms.Description:
You are at a bend in the corridor.  The walls are decorated with
sadistic black murals.  You can see a small room west of here.

Exits.Description: You see the corridor continuing to the east.
You can see the corridor going south.
You see a small room to the west.

Rooms.Name: A practice room
Rooms.Description:
This room has several swords lining the walls.  A mural depicting
Lolth, the Queen of Evil, marks the western wall here.  A sparring
construction has been set up for drow to do battle with.  Several sharp
objects stick out of it.

Exits.Description: You can go back into the corridor.

Rooms.Name: The corridor in the drow palace
Rooms.Description:
This is the northern corridor in the drow palace.  It leads off to the
west and east.  You seem to be standing on some sort of mosaic on the
floor that depicts Lolth doing battle with a hidiously ugly elven lord.

Exits.Description: The corridor goes east.
The corridor goes west.

Rooms.Name: A bend in the corridor
Rooms.Description:
The hallway turns here.  You can follow the mosaic pattern to the west,
or you can go to the south, where the exit is.

Exits.Description: The exit from the palace is south of here.
The corridor goes west.

Rooms.Name: The spiral staircase
Rooms.Description:
A spiral staircase, carved with magic from a single piece of onyx,
glows brightly.  You can probably climb up, if you choose to fight back
the wave of terror that sweeps over you just thinking about it.  Spiders
have built webs that surround the area around the staircase, and scamper
everywhere.

Exits.Description: You can climb the staircase up.
The hallway in the palace is out to the west.

Rooms.Name: An ivory staircase
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing at the base of a magnificent ivory
staircase.  The stairs spiral up into a softly glowing chamber above you.
The ivory itself is a strange substance, with swirls and spirals making up
the individual steps.  There are rooms east and west of here, or you
can follow the landing and return to the north.

Exits.Description: The room above glows softly.
The landing goes back to the north.
You see a small chamber to the east.
You see a chamber through the curtains to the west.

Rooms.Name: Mercurien's Bedroom
Rooms.Description:
This room is dimly lit by candlelight.  A large, plush bed with black
silk sheets fills the room, with little space for anything more than a
small desk and a closet.  The sheets are pulled back a little, and fine
noble-looking clothes are cast around on the bed.  A screen is set up, and
also has clothes hanging from it.  You are not sure, but you think you
might be able to see a figure behind the screen.

Exits.Description: You can go back out into the hallway.

Rooms.Name: Balazar's Chambers
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a room that is rather spartan at first glance.  The
only object of note dominates the room, a massive mosaic mural on the far
wall, depicting a black dragon crawling up a huge unicorn's spire.  The
room has a bed, a desk, and a closet.  It is otherwise empty.

Exits.Description: You can leave this room.

Rooms.Name: At the top of the spiral staircase
Rooms.Description:
You've made it to the top of the spiral staircase.  Cobwebs obscure the
view of what is below.  Atop the banister are two identical statuettes of
spiders, with an intricate spider design leading down the banisters.  You
see a room to the west and a room to the east, and the landing continues
south.

Exits.Description: You see a room east of here.
The landing goes south.
You see a room east of here.
The stairs go down.

Rooms.Name: Arziana's Chambers
Rooms.Description:
This room has a large carpet in the middle of the floor, with a plush
bed against the far wall.  The bed is neatly made.  A closet stands next
to the bed, with a few swords leaning against it.  Tapestries, depicting
great magical battles, line the walls.

Exits.Description: You can leave Arziana's room.

Rooms.Name: Tashken's Room
Rooms.Description:
You brush past a silken curtain into a chamber carved into the
mountain.  The floor is lined with blackened wood, and silks hang from the
ceiling.  Gold and silver plates everything, and decorative swords and
tapestries add to the extravegance here.  A large, four poster bed marks
the center of the room, with a spiral rug at the end.  His desk is
cluttered with paperwork and notes.

Exits.Description: You can go back outto the landing.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
And now, for a zoner's plug.

This zone was written for EliteMud by Nymph.  Work on the zone began
years before it was written, in the form of AD&D games played... yes,
these are MY drow!  What you are exploring is a part of my own campaign,
translated into mud format.  I actually sat down and started writing the
zone on April 16th, 1997.  The zone was completed on April 21st, 1997.

Rooms.Name: The private chambers of the Matron Mother
Rooms.Description:
Kazlyn, the wicked queen of the drow, resides here.  Her highly
decorative and plush bed takes up much of the room, and the silken
blankets from it are scattered around the floor.  Blood stains the bed,
and a corpse is slumped over it - presumably a lover that didn't live
up to her demands.  Mirrors line the walls and ceiling, and an mosaic of
amazing beauty decorates the floor.  Spiders crawl everywhere.

Exits.Description: You can climb down the stairs to the landing.

Rooms.Name: The cave-in
Rooms.Description:
There is a cave in here that blocks off any travel.  You would probably
be wiser to turn back, anyway.  It looks like the cave-in crushed a house
here.

Exits.Description: You can leave this mess.
Hmm, you can squeeze into a hole down from here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like you can move the boulders!

Rooms.Name: The entrance to the Gauntlet
Rooms.Description:
You have stumbled across the drow test of tests known only as the
Gauntlet.  Here, the drow test their mettle against the evil denizens of
this tunnel.  Those rare few who live are regarded as heroes of their
race.

Exits.Description: You can get the hell out of here....
The gauntlet beckons you furthur in...

Rooms.Name: A path in the Gauntlet
Rooms.Description:
You hear things moving all around you.  The earth shakes slightly.  You
can hear rushing water in the distance, but cannot tell where.  The cavern
here is raw granite, not carved or made by drow.  The evil here is a
completely natural evil.

Exits.Description: The path continues.
The path goes back.

Rooms.Name: At the top of a cliff face.
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing atop a large cliff.  It is quite a ways down,
but you think you can climb safely.  There is also a rope ladder that has
been attached south of here, and it looks like you can go down that way,
too. To the east, you see a cave, and you are sure you can jump into it.

Exits.Description: There is a cliff over there, with some movement.  You can jump it.
The rope ladder will not support you if you climb south onto it.
You can go back the way you came.
The climb down looks safe.

Rooms.Name: The Drider's Cave
Rooms.Description:
You seem to have stumbled across the lair of what must be a very large
and powerful drider.  You'd best leave before he returns and takes offense
at your presence here.

Exits.Description: You can wisely run out of this room

Rooms.Name: The rope ladder breaks!
Rooms.Description:
You climb onto the rope ladder and start to travel down it, but it does
not support your weight, and breaks.  You feel your spells failing as you
plummet and get caught up in the rope, and you realize your life is not
going to be very fulfilling.  Suddenly, a gargoyle swoops in to attack!
#YA gargoyle flies in, looking for someone stupid to kill.#N

A gargoyle easily circles around you.
#rSuddenly a gargoyle stabs you in the back!#N
#RThat really did HURT!#N
#rYou scream in pain as a gargoyle critically hits you!
#rA gargoyle ANNIHILATES you with his wicked bite!
#RThat really did HURT!#N
You're stunned, but will probably regain consciousness again.
You are dead!  Moron...

Exits.Description: The exit.

Rooms.Name: Climbing down the cliff
Rooms.Description:
You wisely chose to climb down the cliff, and it has ample handholds.
In fact, you can see where someone was here before you.  There are several
crossbow bolts driven into various places on the cliff, and you think you
can climb down safely!

Exits.Description: You can climb back up, you think.
You can safely climb down.

Rooms.Name: The bottom of the cliff
Rooms.Description:
You are at the bottom of a large underground cliff.  Water splashes up
to the ledge from the east.  You look up, and it looks like you can
actually climb up there.  A cave looms in the west.

Exits.Description: You can climb back up.
The river is rushing to the east, but you can wade through it.
There is a cave to the west.

Rooms.Name: Inside the cave
Rooms.Description:
This cave is cool and quiet, hidden away from the rushing river outside
and the treacherous cliff.  It looks like there is blood on the ground, as
though someone passed this way recently.

Exits.Description: The way out is east.

Rooms.Name: The river of death
Rooms.Description:
This river is known as the river of death, so named for all the lives it
has claimed.  It actually seems rather safe to you, and you wonder what
all the fuss is about.  You hear water rushing east of here, or you can
dive underwater.  There is land to the west.

Exits.Description: You see a violent whirlpool to the east.  It is ripping a drow apart.
You can swim back to the ledge.
You can dive underwater.

Rooms.Name: Underwater
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming under the river of death.  How long can you hold your
breath under here you do not know, but you'd better keep doing it.  The
water is fairly clear.  You can swim east, or try to surface up.

Exits.Description: You can swim to the east.
You can surface.

Rooms.Name: A violent whirlpool
Rooms.Description:
You swim right into the middle of a violent whirlpool.  Blood
splatters all over you as a drow is ripped into shreds, and you quickly
join him as your body is pulled apart into little pieces.  Several hungry
fish descend upon your flesh, and rip you to bits.  You are quite dead.

Exits.Description: The exit.
The exit.
The exit.

Rooms.Name: Under the whirlpool
Rooms.Description:
You are swimming along undernearth a nasty whirlpool.  You're glad you
are on this end, because it looks like someone is being torn apart above
you.  You can swim up into it, if you like, or you can follow the river
floor east or west.

Exits.Description: You can swim east.
You can swim west.
You can be an idiot and swim right into the whirlpool.

Rooms.Name: At the end of the river
Rooms.Description:
You've made it to the end of the river here.  Dry land is east.  The
water is still deep beneath you, and you can dive underneath if you wish,
or you can swim back west into what appears to be a raging whirlpool.

Exits.Description: Dry land is east, and it looks inviting.
You can swim right into the whirlpool and suffer the fate you deserve.
You can dive underwater.

Rooms.Name: Underwater
Rooms.Description:
You are underwater.  The water is cold, but clear.  You think you can
swim up from here, or west.

Exits.Description: You can swim west.
You can surface.

Rooms.Name: Dry land
Rooms.Description:
You are on relatively dry land.  A raging river rushes west of here,
and you can see a whirlpool in the distance in it.  East is a large
cavern, or you can venture north, into the deeper tunnels.

Exits.Description: The tunnels lead north.
You see a cave with signs of life in it.
You can dive into the river.

Rooms.Name: Inside the lair of the Umber Hulk
Rooms.Description:
This cave has been torn out of the very rock.  Something simply waded
in, made the space it wanted, and left.  There is a massive nest of bones
in the middle of the room.  You hear a strange clicking sound.  Safety, or
as safe as the Gauntlet gets, is west.

Exits.Description: You can flee the cave.

Rooms.Name: The tunnel leading north
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel leads north, towards what smells like fresh air.  You might
be almost out of this mess!  The tunnels also leeds south, deeper into the
Gauntlet.  You can hear some noises to the west, and when you glance in
that direction, you think you see pixies and fairies frolicking around a
circle of mushrooms.  You hear music playing.

Exits.Description: You can walk north, towards fresh air.
Do you REALLY think there would be FAIRIES frolicking here?
You can walk back into the Gauntlet.

Rooms.Name: You're stupid if you thought this was a real frolicking..
Rooms.Description:
You wander into the fairies' circle and they invite you to frolick with
them.  For some reason, you feel compelled to join, and you dance and
frolick and strip naked.  The fairies fade away, and so does their magic,
and you find yourself sitting stark naked in the middle of a circle of
bloodthirsty, ravenous driders.  They tear you to bits, and you die a very
unglorious death.  The end.

Exits.Description: The exit.

Rooms.Name: A pitfall
Rooms.Description:
You fall into the bottom of a pit!  It looks like you can actually
climb back up, but you didn't expect the fall.  Fresh air blows in from
the north, and your journey through the Gauntlet looks complete.

Exits.Description: You can walk north to freedom.
You can climb back up the pit, but you couldn't climb back down again.

Rooms.Name: The end of the Gauntlet
Rooms.Description:
You can see the exit of the caves a short distance to the north.  It
isn't far now.  The tunnels also go deeper into the caves to the south,
but that fresh air that is blowing in is terribly refreshing.  A few runes
are carved into the ground here, and they translate into a drow proverb.
It says, "So you did it once.  Bet you'll die the second time..."

Exits.Description: You can wander back into the caves.

Mobs.Name: drow sentry
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow sentry is standing here, ready to slay any intruders.
Mobs.Description:
The dark elf has shocking white hair and pitch black skin.  His eyes glow
bright red, and are very fierce.

Mobs.Name: spider small
Mobs.LongDescription: A small spider scampers around here.
Mobs.Description: This small spider is probably very poisonous.

Mobs.Name: drider
Mobs.LongDescription: A bloated, evil looking drider is looking for food.
Mobs.Description:
The drider is a drow from the waist up, but the rest is a massive, horrid
spider.

Mobs.Name: spider widow large
Mobs.LongDescription: A large black widow is crawling on the wall.
Mobs.Description: The black widow is easily identified by the red hourglass on its back.

Mobs.Name: captive woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A woman stands here, sobbing.
Mobs.Description:
This woman is weak and feeble from her stay in the pen.  You think you can
make out what appears to be an Elite clan symbol on her clothes.

Mobs.Name: captive elf girl
Mobs.LongDescription: A young elven girl stands here, looking for a way to escape.
Mobs.Description:
This girl is bold and defiant.  You think you can see the Elysium symbol
embroidered on her dress.

Mobs.Name: squire human prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A squire stands here, looking for a way to escape.
Mobs.Description:
This young man is hurt from an escape attempt.  You think you can make out
a blazing phoenix on his tabard.

Mobs.Name: ratman prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A ratman prisoner is trying to rebel against his drow masters.
Mobs.Description:
This young ratman, proudly wearing a Guerilla headband, is trying to break
his shackles.

Mobs.Name: troll prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A troll prisoner is nursing his burn wounds.
Mobs.Description:
This troll was captured in a raid into Midgaard.  You think he is wearing
the colors of the Malina clan.

Mobs.Name: vampire prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A vampire prisoner has been exposed to sunlight.
Mobs.Description:
This vampire is wearing a noble's seal of the Night Tribe.  He looks quite
hurt from his burns.

Mobs.Name: dwarf shackled warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven warrior pulls mightily against his chains.
Mobs.Description:
This dwarf has been beaten across the head.  You can see the torn tabard
of the Divine Powers clan.

Mobs.Name: dwarf chained warrior prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarven prisoner seems half-crazed.
Mobs.Description:
This dwarf has scars all over his back.  You can see the feared symbol of
the Army of Darkness tattooed on his back, with the word "Geefunk" written
beneath it.

Mobs.Name: fairy prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A fairy prisoner is standing here, crying.
Mobs.Description:
This fairy is bloodied and hurt.  She is wearing a dress typically worn by
Artemisians.  Her wings have been plucked.

Mobs.Name: shogun samurai prisoner captured
Mobs.LongDescription: A samurai prisoner is chained to the wall.
Mobs.Description:
The samurai is saddened and wants to regain his honor.  He is wearing the
distinctive symbol of the Shogun clan.

Mobs.Name: dwarf prisoner insane moc derro
Mobs.LongDescription: An insane derro prisoner is here, cackling madly.
Mobs.Description:
This dwarf has gone quite insane.  He has the words "Minions of Chaos"
written across his chest in blood.  His own blood, probably.

Mobs.Name: woman elf prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven prisoner is here, sighing about her fate.
Mobs.Description:
This woman has the symbol of the sun on her shirt, quite stained from her
tribulations.

Mobs.Name: half elf prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A half-elven prisoner scowls, wanting to break free.
Mobs.Description:
This half elf has the triangular symbol of the TRI clan on his shirt.  It
is covered in blood, probably his own.

Mobs.Name: vampire shadowblade sb prisoner captured
Mobs.LongDescription: A captured vampire is chained to the wall.
Mobs.Description:
This vampire wishes to break free.  She is always looking around for a way
to escape her chains.  She has the symbol of the Shadowblades tattooed on
her neck.

Mobs.Name: lizardman prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A lizardman prisoner is here, hitting the wall in frustration.
Mobs.Description:
The lizardman has several scales torn from his scalp, and is bleeding
rather badly.  He bears the symbol of the Storm Dragons on his sash.

Mobs.Name: prisoner dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A dwarf is chained here, grinning madly.
Mobs.Description:
This dwarf seems quite insane.  He is standing on some bones of some
creature he smashed.  He's also naked, and you can see the letters "TKK"
tattooed on his arse.

Mobs.Name: werewolf pack prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A werewolf is here, raging against his shackles.
Mobs.Description:
This werewolf seems very old and grey.  He is trying to break his shackles
and be free so that he can run with his pack once again.

Mobs.Name: drow noble
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow noble is walking around.
Mobs.Description:
The drow has pitch black skin and pure white hair, and a light colored
goatee.  He wears all black, and looks very evil.

Mobs.Name: drow master swordmaster
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow swordmaster is here, instructing the youth.
Mobs.Description: The drow swordmaster does not look it, but he is very old and wise.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%25 emote gives a few tips on how to fight.

Mobs.Name: drow student
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow student is here, sparring.
Mobs.Description: He must be very swift and deadly, or he will just end up a corpse.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 test;%25 emote lunges in a practice swing.

Mobs.Name: slartiin wizard old man
Mobs.LongDescription: Slartiin the Stupendous, the great wizard, is exploring.
Mobs.Description: Slartiin is very old and wise.  His beard touches the ground.

Mobs.Name: nude drow woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A mostly nude drow woman is standing here, shouting at you.
Mobs.Description:
This drow woman is incredibly beautiful, but you don't have the time to
admire her assets.  She seems quite angry with you.

Mobs.Name: bathing drow woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is here, taking a relaxing bath.
Mobs.Description:
This woman is incredibly beautiful.  You guess correctly that the dark
elves kill the women who do not look beautiful.

Mobs.Name: drow torturer
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, delighting in torture.
Mobs.Description:
This dark elf is particularly sadistic.  He is in charge of torturing
anyone the Matron Mother does not like.

Mobs.Name: drow servant
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is serving his superiors.
Mobs.Description:
This drow wears very little, and is careful not to upset his superiors,
lest he become dinner.

Mobs.Name: drow guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow guard is standing here, ready to slay any intruders.
Mobs.Description:
The dark elf has shocking white hair and pitch black skin.  His eyes glow
bright red, and are very fierce.

Mobs.Name: drow weaponsmith
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow weaponsmith is here, labouring on a sword.
Mobs.Description:
This drow is very old and venerable.  Drow look very young until they are
about 600 or 700 years old, so he must be incredibly old.  His hair is
almost yellow, and his skin is starting to grey, but he still looks very
dangerous.

Mobs.Name: drow armourer
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow armourer is here, working on a mithril shirt.
Mobs.Description:
The drow armourer seems to be very old, and is probably a deadly opponent.
He knows how to make armour so he is not attacked by his superiors.  His
inferiors just die.

Mobs.Name: drow merchant
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow merchant is here, offering to sell his goods.
Mobs.Description:
This drow seems to be quite old and wise.  He wears a seal that is the
symbol of an ancient drow house, but only Azzinoden lives in this city.
He must be either very talented or very powerful to be left alive.  He is
the merchant for the city.

Mobs.Name: drow retelzin wizard magician
Mobs.LongDescription: Retelzin Azzinoden, the drow magician, works in his laboratory.
Mobs.Description:
Retelzin is a much respected magician amongst the drow.  Many people come
to buy his rare and powerful magic.

Mobs.Name: drow commoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow commoner is here, walking around the streets.
Mobs.Description:
This drow appears very young and nimble.  He is probably a deadly
opponent.

Mobs.Name: drow prisoner
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow prisoner is here, wanting to escape torture.
Mobs.Description:
This drow has burn marks all over his skin and back.  He probably upset
Kazlyn.

Mobs.Name: drow masseuse
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, giving massages to the women.
Mobs.Description:
This is one of the many unimportant dark elves.  He has been forced to
give massages to the other drow, but it's a cushy task, so who cares?

Mobs.Name: drow woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is naked from the waist up, and is getting a massage.
Mobs.Description:
This dark elf is very lovely.  She is quite beautiful, with very long
white flowing hair streaming across her shoulders.  She seems to enjoy the
massages that are her right.

Mobs.Name: akkadian paladin
Mobs.LongDescription: Akkadian, a young paladin, explores the tunnels.
Mobs.Description:
Akkadian is a young knight that has been exploring the tunnels with his
friends.  He wears the symbol of the Dimaron Lords.  His brown hair is cut
short, but he is very well groomed.

Mobs.Name: fredrick friar
Mobs.LongDescription: Friar Fredrick is here, bringing aid to the prisoners.
Mobs.Description:
The friar is a priest of Chronias, the god of all that is good in the
world.  He is rather large himself, and probably drinks too much of his
sacremental wines.  His beard is very, very, very fuzzy.
Mobs.ActionScript: %1 test;%20 emote waves his mace.;%15 burp;%20 say Repent!

Mobs.Name: pem
Mobs.LongDescription: Pem stands here, ready with his spear.
Mobs.Description:
Pem is a healthy young man.  He adventures with Friar Fredrick and wants
to buy a farm one day.

Mobs.Name: spider massive poison
Mobs.LongDescription: A massive poisonous spider is eating a dead drow.
Mobs.Description: This spider is just absolutely huge.

Mobs.Name: noble woman drow
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow noblewoman looks at you haughtily.
Mobs.Description:
This dark elf is quite attractive and domineering.  She has her white hair
braided so that she can fight with it.  Her skin is pitch black, and is
flawless.

Mobs.Name: drow woman
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow woman is here, walking around the streets.
Mobs.Description:
This drow appears very young and nimble.  She is probably a deadly
opponent.

Mobs.Name: kazlyn drow matron mother
Mobs.LongDescription: Kazlyn, the Matron Mother, looks around arrogantly.
Mobs.Description:
Kazlyn is extremely powerful.  She is quite deadly, and knows almost
everything there is to know about magic.  In her life she has attacked
many wizards, and killed them all, just to prove that she is the best.
Her billowy white hair catches a breeze lightly, and her fierce green eyes
miss nothing.

Mobs.Name: tashken drow
Mobs.LongDescription: Lord Tashken stands here, eyeing you calmly.
Mobs.Description:
Tashken is an old and noble drow.  He is a quick fighter, and has only
ever been defeated once, by his wayward son, Corbaine.  He serves the
Matron Mother and is her current favorite.  He keeps his hair trimmed
short, and his goatee groomed.

Mobs.Name: drow assassin
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow assassin leaps to kill you!
Mobs.Description: This dark elf is an extremely deadly enemy.  He is trained to kill.

Mobs.Name: arziana drow
Mobs.LongDescription: Arziana is standing here, smiling slyly.
Mobs.Description:
Arziana is the daughter of Kazlyn, and as such, is the first in line to
become the Matron Mother.  She is, herself, very attractive, and quite
deadly when she needs to be.

Mobs.Name: mercurien drow
Mobs.LongDescription: Mercurien would like to know why you are in her chambers.
Mobs.Description:
Mercurien is Tashken's first wife, and the sister to Kazlyn.  She is
rather distressed lately, and her appearance shows this.  Her skin has
taken on a grey hue.

Mobs.Name: denzar drow
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, nursing his wounds.
Mobs.Description:
This dark elf is young and haughty.  His skin is rock black, and his hair
is snow white.  He keeps his hair cut short, and has grown a soft, white
goatee.  His eyes are a fierce green.  For some reason, he has fled into
the Gauntlet.

Mobs.Name: studying drow
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, studying.
Mobs.Description: This dark elf is busy studying.  You don't think he even sees you.

Mobs.Name: large drider
Mobs.LongDescription: A very large drider is here, looking for someone to slaughter.
Mobs.Description:
This is quite possibly the largest drider you have ever seen.  It is very
large, and looks very hungry.

Mobs.Name: piranha snake huge
Mobs.LongDescription: An absolutely huge piranha snake swims around, looking for food.
Mobs.Description:
This animal is long, white, and has lots of teeth, but if you grab it
behind the ears, it's harmless!

Mobs.Name: umber hulk
Mobs.LongDescription: A huge umber hulk rips the cliff apart.
Mobs.Description:
The umber hulk has 4 eyes, and huge mandibles.  It can tear through sheer
rock without a scratch on its hard plated skin.

Mobs.Name: drow hunter
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow hunter is chasing down his foe.
Mobs.Description:
Drow hunters are very deadly opponents, and are dedicated to the complete
annihilation of their enemies.  This one is employed by Kazlyn herself.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle
Mobs.LongDescription: A gargoyle swoops to attack!
Mobs.Description:
This is a very large and dangerous looking gargoyle.  He is made of almost
solid rock, and looks very heavy.  His claws are extraordinairily sharp.

Mobs.Name: cave troll green
Mobs.LongDescription: A putrid green cave troll hisses madly.
Mobs.Description:
You've seen the trolls in the Troll caves, but this guy looks REAL mean.
He is huge, spindly and green, and oozes puss.  His muscles ripple when he
burps.

Mobs.Name: drow elite guard
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow elite guard refuses to let you pass.
Mobs.Description:
This dark elf is in the service of Kazlyn.  It is his job to stop people
from entering the palace without permission.

Mobs.Name: balazar drow
Mobs.LongDescription: Lord Balazar stands here, eyeing you skeptically.
Mobs.Description:
Balazar is the son of Kazlyn, and is very important in the structure of
House Azzinoden.  He keeps his white hair groomed and long, and is clean
shaven.  His eyes are a horrid orange color.

Mobs.Name: drow noble sparring
Mobs.LongDescription: A drow is here, sparring with the air.
Mobs.Description: This noble is fighting the air, practicing his skills.

Mobs.Name: duck malard montgomery
Mobs.LongDescription: A duck is here, quacking happily.
Mobs.Description: This duck is very smart and talented.

Mobs.Name: michael garn megaron
Mobs.LongDescription: Michael Garn is standing here, grinning demomically.
Mobs.Description:
Michael is a vile and wretched man.  He has many powers that come from
supernatural sources, and is an extremly deadly foe.  He is the sworn
enemy of Denzar, and wishes to kill that dark elf.

Mobs.Name: bandar nazet half drow
Mobs.LongDescription: Bandar Nazet, the deadly half-drow, keeps his bow aimed at you.
Mobs.Description:
Bandar is one of the most feared heroes of the drow, period.  He died
many, many years ago, in a famous struggle against the elven priest-kings, 
but dark and dangerous magic has resurrected him.  He was most well know
for his archery, and is reputed to have never, ever missed a shot.  He
keeps his white hair trimmed short, and wears a thin mustache and goatee.
The brand of House Nazet is clear on his exposed shoulder.

Objects.Name: cabbage magic wand
Objects.Description: A cabbage is sitting on the ground, doing nothing.

Objects.Description: A black longsword rests against the wall.

Objects.Name: green pointed wizard hat
Objects.Description: A green pointed hat is hovering in front of you.

Objects.Name: spider hilted dagger
Objects.Description: A dagger with spider legs seems to crawl around.

Objects.Name: leather white knight belt
Objects.Description: A long, white leather belt is looped on the ground.

Objects.Name: onyx hilted longsword
Objects.Description: A slender, silver blade with a black handle is on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The sword is made of gleaming white steel, with silver inlay running up
the length of the blade.  An emblem of a black dragon is crawling up the
sword from the hilt.  The hilt has an emerald on both sides.

Objects.Description: A cloak is piled up in a heap.

Objects.Description: A spear is here, its blade glinting oddly.

Objects.Description: A wand is here, with spiders all over it.

Objects.Description: A bottle of fermented gnome sits here.

Objects.Name: spider morsel
Objects.Description: A tasty steamed spider!  What a treat.
